# pve_sdn_ip_manage (Action)

Create/update an IP mapping (MAC/IP/VMID) in a VNet via its IPAM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_sdn_ip_manage" "example" {
  config {
  ip = "CHANGE_ME"
  vnet = "CHANGE_ME"
  zone = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_sdn_ip_manage.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address to associate with the given MAC address
- `vnet` (String) The SDN vnet object identifier.
- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier.

### Optional

- `mac` (String) Unicast MAC address.
